venues.name: Greek Theatre
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available through Ticketmaster and the Box Office. When ordering tickets, it is important to indicate that you require accessible seating so we can properly seat you. To secure ADA seating do any one of the following: * On-Line at www.ticketmaster.com - select your event, and then click on the "Accessible Seating" icon to purchase. * Call Ticketmaster at (800) 877 7575 * Visit one of Ticketmaster's outlets. Accessible parking is available in several locations; behind the box office (very limited availability), as well as Lots B, C and G. Parking lot entrances are off Vermont Avenue. All lots include spaces for rear-loading and side-loading vans and have accessible paths of travel to seating areas. Greek Theatre parking is very limited, including accessible parking which frequently sells out in advance. Accessible parking is also available in the off-site shuttle parking lot located at Crystal Springs Drive/Los Feliz Blvd. All Shuttles are ADA accessible.
